strings_ref.name: jethexa_large_model_tip
strings_ref.zh:
"功能体验前需要参考下述步骤连接局域网与配置大模型API Key： 
(1)返回到手机APP设备搜索界面，点击界面右下方的“+”按钮，接着点击“局域网模式”按钮，按照界面操作指引连接局域网。 
(2)在当前手机APP“大模型”功能界面，点击右上方的密钥按钮，参考大模型API Key配置资料获取大模型API Key并填写设置。 

点击“开始”按钮，等待“准备就绪”语音播报后，说出“小幻小幻”唤醒机器人，即可参考以下示例机器进行对话,等待任务总结的语音播报后，可进行下一次对话。 
任务结束后未检测到语言命令时机器人会播报“咚”的语音播报，则需要重新唤醒机器人。 

示例1：描述一下你看到了什么？ 
示例2：给我讲个笑话吧。 
示例3：今天深圳市的天气怎么样？ 
示例4：往前走两步，然后再左平移三步。 
示例5：给我看看前方障碍物距离你多少厘米？ 
示例6：沿着黑色的线走，遇到障碍物就停下。"
strings_ref.en:
"Before using this feature, please follow the steps below to connect to the local network (LAN) and configure your large AI model API Key: 

(1) Return to the device search screen in the App. Tap the \"+\" button in the bottom right corner, select \"LAN Mode\", and follow the on-screen instructions to connect to your local network. 
(2) On the current \"Large Model\" screen, tap the key icon in the top right corner. Refer to the API Key configuration guide to obtain and enter your API Key. 

Tap the \"Start\" button and wait for the \"I'm ready\" voice prompt. Say \"Hello, Hiwonder\" to wake up the robot. You can then converse with the robot using the examples below. Please wait until the robot finishes its response before starting your next command. 
If no voice command is detected after a task is finished, the robot will emit a \"dong\" sound, indicating that you need to wake it up again. 

Example 1: Describe what you see. 
Example 2: Tell me a joke. 
Example 3: What is the weather like in New York today? 
Example 4: Move forward two steps, then strafe left three steps. 
Example 5: Tell me the distance to the obstacle in front of you. 
Example 6: Follow the black line and stop when you encounter an obstacle."

strings_ref.name: gesture_tip
strings_ref.zh: 右手握拳举到摄像头视野中央，五指张开，在听到滴一声后，往上下左右其中一个方向移动手掌（注意：移动时手掌需要保持张开状态）。移动一段距离后握拳，滴一声后机器将开始移动。
strings_ref.en: First, position your right fist in the center of camera, then open your palm. Once you hear a sound from robot, move your hand in one direction (up, down, right, or left) for a specific distance. Note that you should keep your palm open throughout this process. Then, make a fist again. As robot recognizes your movement, it will emit another sound and begin to move accordingly.

zh.gesture_tips10:
"2.动态手势
先将右手五指张开，待识别到five后，蜂鸣器'滴'一声，可以开始画线，画线过程中会有黄色轨迹显示，右手握拳蜂鸣器'滴'一声，结束画线。机器人会根据轨迹进行移动，支持上滑、下滑、左滑、右滑对应前进、后退、左平移、右平移，根据轨迹长度控制机器人移动距离。"
zh.gesture_tips2:
"启动后，可以识别静态手势和动态手势。
1.静态手势
可将拇指食指比心、OK手势、握拳等，识别成功后机器人会做出相应动作。
2.动态手势
先将五指张开，待识别到five后，只伸出食指，其他手指握拳。等识别到one，可以开始画线，画线过程中会有红色显示画线轨迹，画出线后再张开五指结束画线。目前支持左滑、右滑、上滑、下滑、对应左侧移、右侧移、前进、后退，每个指令都会执行几步后停止。"

"启动后，可以识别静态手势。
可将拇指食指比心、OK手势、握拳等，识别成功后机器人会做出相应动作。"

zh.jethexa_large_model_tip:
"功能体验前需要参考下述步骤连接局域网与配置大模型API Key： 
(1)返回到手机APP设备搜索界面，点击界面右下方的“+”按钮，接着点击“局域网模式”按钮，按照界面操作指引连接局域网。 
(2)在当前手机APP“大模型”功能界面，点击右上方的密钥按钮，参考大模型API Key配置资料获取大模型API Key并填写设置。 

点击“开始”按钮，等待“准备就绪”语音播报后，说出“小幻小幻”唤醒机器人，即可参考以下示例机器进行对话,等待任务总结的语音播报后，可进行下一次对话。 
任务结束后未检测到语言命令时机器人会播报“咚”的语音播报，则需要重新唤醒机器人。 

示例1：描述一下你看到了什么？ 
示例2：给我讲个笑话吧。 
示例3：今天深圳市的天气怎么样？ 
示例4：往前走两步，然后再左平移三步。 
示例5：给我看看前方障碍物距离你多少厘米？ 
示例6：沿着黑色的线走，遇到障碍物就停下。"

zh.threshold_instruction:
"L代表亮度，越大，亮度越高
a代表从绿色到红色的分量
b代表从蓝色到黄色的分量
L_min和L_max、a_min和a_max、b_min和b_max都代表识别的值范围，比如我们要识别蓝色物体，步骤如下：
1.在选择颜色框选中蓝色
2.将b_min调节为最小值0（观察Lab颜色模型图表明蓝色b值较小）
3.逐步调节b_max，观察左上的图像，若蓝色物体在图像中显示比较完整的白色，非蓝色物体显示黑色就代表调好了
4.点击保存"
zh.threshold_instruction_1: L代表亮度，越大，亮度越高
zh.threshold_instruction_2: A代表从绿色到红色的分量
zh.threshold_instruction_3: B代表从蓝色到黄色的分量
zh.threshold_instruction_4: LAB相较于RGB与CMYK等颜色空间更符合人类视觉，也更容易调整：想要调节亮度就调节L通道，想要只调节色彩平衡就分别调A和B。

base.jethexa_gesture_tips1: Note: The robot only recognizes right-hand gestures. For best results, keep your palm facing the camera.
base.jethexa_gesture_tips2:
"Once started, the robot can recognize the following two types of gestures: 
1. Static Gesture Recognition 
Supported gestures include: Thumb Up, OK, Rock, and Yes. Upon successful recognition, the robot will automatically execute the corresponding preset action. 
2. Dynamic Gesture Recognition 
First, open your right hand with five fingers spread. Once the system recognizes the \"five\" gesture, the buzzer will beep, and you can begin drawing a trajectory. 
During the drawing process, the screen will display a yellow trajectory line in real-time. 
Once completed, make a fist with your right hand, and the buzzer will beep again to end the trajectory recording. 
The robot will move according to the drawn trajectory: supporting Swipe Up (Forward), Swipe Down (Backward), Swipe Left (Translate Left), and Swipe Right (Translate Right), with the movement distance determined by the length of the trajectory."
base.jethexa_large_model_tip:
"Before using this feature, please follow the steps below to connect to the local network (LAN) and configure your large AI model API Key: 

(1) Return to the device search screen in the App. Tap the \"+\" button in the bottom right corner, select \"LAN Mode\", and follow the on-screen instructions to connect to your local network. 
(2) On the current \"Large Model\" screen, tap the key icon in the top right corner. Refer to the API Key configuration guide to obtain and enter your API Key. 

Tap the \"Start\" button and wait for the \"I'm ready\" voice prompt. Say \"Hello, Hiwonder\" to wake up the robot. You can then converse with the robot using the examples below. Please wait until the robot finishes its response before starting your next command. 
If no voice command is detected after a task is finished, the robot will emit a \"dong\" sound, indicating that you need to wake it up again. 

Example 1: Describe what you see. 
Example 2: Tell me a joke. 
Example 3: What is the weather like in New York today? 
Example 4: Move forward two steps, then strafe left three steps. 
Example 5: Tell me the distance to the obstacle in front of you. 
Example 6: Follow the black line and stop when you encounter an obstacle."

base.threshold_instruction:
"\"L\" refers to brightness.Brightness increases as the value increases.

\"a\" refers to the value from green to red.

\"b\" refers to the value from blue to yellow.

L_min and L_max, a_min and a_max, b_min and b_max are the range of recognized values. 

If you want to recognize blue object, the steps are as follows:
1. Select blue in the box.
2. Adjust b_min to the minimum value 0, because blue \"b\" value is small in the Lab color model diagram.
3. Observe and adjust the white shape in the upper left frame to be the same as the blue sample, and other objects are in black.
4. Click \"Save\"."
base.threshold_instruction_1: L stands for brightness. The higher the value, the higher the brightness.
base.threshold_instruction_2: A is the component from green to red.
base.threshold_instruction_3: B is the component from blue to yellow.
base.threshold_instruction_4: Compared with RGB, CMYK and other color spaces, lab is more in line with human vision and easier to adjust: if you want to adjust the brightness, adjust the L channel; if you want to only adjust the color balance, adjust a and B respectively.
